mapper.select:
select d.TRADE_ID as tradeId,
acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr, zc.FINPROD_ID as assetId, zc.FINPROD_ABBR as assetAbbr, d.PS as psCode, d.PS as ps, d.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarketCode, d.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarket, '' as 清算速度, DATE_FORMAT(d.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as tradeDate, DATE_FORMAT(d.SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as settleDate, d.INV_AIM as invAimCode, d.INV_AIM as invAim, '' as 结算方式, IFNULL( (case when d.TRADER = 'null' then null else d.TRADER end) ,'') as trader,
d.is_out_trade as isOutTradeCode, d.is_out_trade as isOutTrade, d.COUNTER_ID as counterId,
'' as 对手方交易员,
sma.SEC_ACCT_NAME as secManageAcctId, d.CHL_ID as chlId, d.CCY as ccyCode, d.CCY as ccy, IFNULL(d.PAR_VALUE,0)*IFNULL(d.PRIN_AMT,0) as prinAmt, d.share_Amt*100 as shareAmt, d.UNIT_CPRICE as unitCprice, d.UNIT_INT as unitInt, d.UNIT_FPRICE as unitFprice, d.CPRICE_AMT as cpriceAmt, d.INT_AMT as intAmt, d.FPRICE_AMT as fpriceAmt, d.FEE_AMT_PAY as feeAmtPay, d.FEE_AMT_UNPAY as feeAmtUnpay, d.FEE_AMT as feeAmt, tdf.FEE_AMT as tdFeeAmt,
d.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt, (d.YIELD) * 100 as yield, (d.EXER_YIELD) * 100 as exerYield, d.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatusCode, d.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatus,
DATE_FORMAT(d.VDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as vdate, DATE_FORMAT(d.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as mdate, d.PAR_VALUE as parValue, d.PRIN_AMT as prinAmt from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d inner join FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = d.finprod_id
left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id
inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = d.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO cust_out on cust_out.customer_id = d.counter_id left join FIN_PRODUCT cust_in on cust_in.finprod_id = d.counter_id left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09'
left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO sma on sma.SEC_ACCT_ID = d.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}
